title: Hushed Flaky British Salmon Trifle
description: A savory trifle featuring flaky poached salmon, tangy pomegranate molasses, and a creamy sauce, ideal for a hearty British meal-prep.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat, season salmon with salt and pepper, and sear both sides until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side, then transfer to a shallow dish.
Pour pomegranate molasses and lemon juice over the seared salmon, add dill, parsley, and grated ginger, and let the salmon rest for 5 minutes to absorb flavors.
Whisk together heavy cream, Dijon mustard, and capers until smooth, then fold in a pinch of salt.
Toast baguette slices in a dry skillet until golden, then cut into small cubes and scatter them in the dish as a base layer.
Arrange poached salmon slices on top of the bread crumbs, then pour the cream sauce evenly over the salmon.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the top and place the dish in the oven for 10 minutes to meld the flavors.
Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, then refrigerate overnight to allow the trifle to set before serving chilled or at room temperature.
